claim_tested: Does the isolated ARHGAP23 PDZ bind class I C-terminal peptides?
key_finding: 82 peptides measured (76 class I, 4 class II, 2 class III); 0 binders, max pKd 0.00. Same 82 peptides: ARHGAP21 binds 23 (pKd 3.45-5.01). Wilcoxon p=1.35e-05.
context: Recombinant His6-MBP-PDZ in E. coli lysate, 10-mer biotinylated peptides, in vitro
confidence_and_limitations: High confidence in the measurement. Isolated domain; construct boundaries not published; 82 peptides is a biased sample of C-terminal space.

claim_tested: How much does the ARHGAP23 zero establish?
key_finding: 25/266 domains bound nothing; all 25 tested on the same 82-peptide panel. 0 of 82 excludes per-peptide hit rates >=0.036 (exact p<0.05); P(0 of 82)=7.6e-04 at the median rate of domains tested on >60 peptides.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Excludes promiscuous and moderately selective binding; does not exclude narrow specificity.

claim_tested: Can a domain with a documented ligand score zero in an isolated-domain screen?
key_finding: Syntenin PDZ2, a zero-binder in E1, is the high-affinity syndecan-binding domain, but isolated PDZ1 or PDZ2 do not interact with syndecan bait; the PDZ1-PDZ2 tandem is the functional unit.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Establishes the false-negative mode of E1 by positive control.

claim_tested: Is the groove intact and can it read a P-2 S/T?
key_finding: Kabsch onto 1BE9: 1.66 A CA RMSD over 43 anchors. Transferred CRIPT peptide: 0 backbone clashes, closest contact 3.07 A. Tyr133 OH to P-2 Thr OG1 2.48 A (PSD-95 His372 NE2: 2.59 A).
context: Predicted monomer; pLDDT 85 at alphaB1, 87.2 across alphaB
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate-high for the fold; a model, and a transferred ligand is not a measured complex.

claim_tested: Where does the PDZ domain start?
key_finding: GPhiGPhi carboxylate loop is G53-F54-G55-F56 with Lys48 at the PSD-95 Arg318 position. UniProt PDZ 71-155 excludes it. ARHGAP21 50-159 includes its G59-F60-G61-F62. InterPro 52-155, SSF50156 19-156, CDD cd06756 41-152.
confidence_and_limitations: High. A reproducible annotation defect in the source record.

citation: Own census of the reviewed human PDZome
key_finding: 250 confidently aligned PDZ instances from 155 proteins: His 131 (52.4%), Leu 17, Arg 16, Tyr 12 (4.8%), Asn 11, Phe 11. Tyr-alphaB1 set: PDZD2, PDZK1, PDZK1P1, CYTIP, PRX, AHNAK2, DEPTOR, PCLO, RADIL, NOS1, ARHGAP21, ARHGAP23.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Tyr-alphaB1 is a minority class whose specificity is not systematically characterised.

claim_tested: Does the family groove accept a peptide?
key_finding: 1.72 A CA RMSD to 1BE9 over 68 positions. Tyr98 OH to transferred P-2 OG1 2.00-8.03 A (median 3.37), within 3.5 A in 13/20 models. Backbone clashes 1-25 per model, never zero.
context: Apo structural-genomics NMR; ARHGAP23 has 0 PDB entries
confidence_and_limitations: Low-moderate. Residual clashes read as apo loop imprecision, not an occluded groove.

claim_tested: Do the deposited interactions show a class I preference?
key_finding: 383/562 records (68%) come from E1. The 18 ARHGAP23 partners are all members of the 82-peptide measured set with pKd=0. Proteome-background class I OR 8.54 p=8.6e-84 collapses under a library-matched null (ARHGAP21 p=0.69, DLG1 p=0.94, SCRIB p=0.81, SNX27 p=0.20).
confidence_and_limitations: Artefact of the peptide library's 71% class I composition. Withdrawn as evidence.

claim_tested: Does the family bind class I ligands?
key_finding: WNV NS5 PBM binds the ARHGAP21 PDZ; reproduced in E1 as ARHGAP21's top binder at pKd 5.01. ARHGAP23 scores 0.00 on the same peptide.
confidence_and_limitations: High for ARHGAP21, and a direct negative for ARHGAP23.
